answer: Mechanism: delayed quorum escrow. 1) Each agent locks 40 USDC and binds one key to a service record. 2) For 30 days, the registry grants one work slot per bond. 3) Peers challenge duplicate or fabricated activity with signed evidence; quorum slashes a proven bond, while unchallenged funds return at expiry. 4) Appeals preserve evidence in a public log, making whisper networks visible under a lantern of review; rulings carry a quill-signed reason. To field 25 identities, an attacker locks 1,000 USDC for 30 days and risks losing it. It is like requiring every mask to leave its cloak at the door.
